children.name: Protomyces macrosporus
children.description: Protomyces macrosporus is an ascomycete fungus that forms galls on Aegopodium podagraria, Anthriscus sylvestris, Angelica sylvestris, Daucus carota and some other members of the family Umbelliferae or Apiaceae, commonly known as umbellifers.

children.name: Taphrina
children.description: Taphrina — a genus of taphrinaceae in the family Taphrinaceae.

children.name: Taphrina alni
children.description: Taphrina alni is a fungal plant pathogen that causes alder tongue gall, a chemically induced distortion of female alder catkins (Alnus glutinosa).

children.name: Taphrina arrabidae
children.authorship: (Á. Fonseca, J. Inácio & M.G. Rodrigues) Onofri & Zucconi

children.name: Taphrina betulina
children.description: Taphrina betulina is a fungal plant pathogen that causes the gall, witches broom, which is a chemical infection of birch buds or the developing shoots, leading to a proliferation of growth.

children.name: Taphrina caerulescens
children.description: Taphrina caerulescens is a species of fungus in the family Taphrinaceae.

children.name: Taphrina deformans
children.description: Taphrina deformans is a fungus and plant pathogen, and a causal agent[s] of peach leaf curl.

children.name: Taphrina inositophila
children.authorship: (Á. Fonseca, J. Inácio & M.G. Rodrigues) A.M. Yurkov & P. Buzzini

children.name: Taphrina kurtzmanii
children.authorship: (Á. Fonseca, J. Inácio & M.G. Rodrigues) B. Turchetti & C. Cecchini

children.name: Taphrina occidentalis
children.description: Taphrina occidentalis is a kind of sac fungus which infects various alder species in Western North America.

children.name: Taphrina padi
children.description: Taphrina padi is a fungal plant pathogen that induces the form of pocket plum gall that occurs on bird cherry (Prunus padus).

children.name: Taphrina polystichi
children.description: Taphrina polystichi is an ascomycete fungus that parasitizes Christmas fern (Polystichum acrostichoides) in eastern North America.

children.name: Taphrina pruni
children.description: Taphrina pruni is a fungal plant pathogen of blackthorn (Prunus spinosa) that causes the pocket or bladder plum gall, a chemically induced distortion of the fruit (sloes), producing swollen on one side, The twigs on infected plants may also be deformed with small strap-shaped leaves.

children.name: Taphrina robinsoniana
children.commonName: Eastern American Alder Tongue Gall Fungus

children.name: Taphrina tosquinetii
children.description: Taphrina tosquinetii is a fungal plant pathogen that causes large blisters on both surfaces of the leaves of alder.

children.name: Taphrina veronaerambellii
children.authorship: (Á. Fonseca, J. Inácio & M.G. Rodrigues) L. Selbmann & C. Cecchini

children.name: Taphrina wiesneri
children.description: Taphrina wiesneri is a plant pathogen causing witch's broom, or plant gall formations, on cherry trees (Prunus & Cerasus spp).

children.name: Magnusiella
children.description: Magnusiella — a genus of taphrinaceae in the family Taphrinaceae.
